notes: «وحدثناه» after the saying starts a second isnad of the same saying: a second group
The second group ends «بهذا الإسناد»: kept as a back_reference; no previous report is supplied, so its names are not inherited
«فقال عبد الله أنسي الناس» is the same Ibn Mas'ud already in the chain; «عبد الله» is the first occurrence
The later «فقال مثل ذلك» for Ibn Mas'ud, Hudhayfa and Zayd is a scene of asking, not added as routes
